instrument: Hillsboro Community Development Code amendment (data and energy storage), council readings
summary: Planning Commission recommended the Phase 1 amendment Sept 9; City Council first reading Oct 6 and second reading Oct 20, 2026, with public comment at both. Moratorium runs to Nov 24; council may extend six months.
text: October 6: City Council first reading of proposed code amendments (public comment accepted) October 20: City Council second reading of proposed code amendments (public comment accepted)

source.citation: City of Hillsboro, 'Data Centers in Hillsboro: Next Steps After Moratorium'

notes: Companion to or-hillsboro-8502-* entries. CONFLICT (claims queue): News-Times reports 17 enterprise zone applications from 8 entities; Herald figure was 18 pending agreements.
